column1: # Every figure below comes from a run in results.md (task T20, #3354),
# measured with -workers 2 and -Xmx4g at revision 8ee0bd2; each row names
# the results.md row it rests on. A band is about 1 to 2 percent either
# side of the measured distinct figure (the smoke rows of AgentProtocol
# and AgentEffects, the two-generations positive and the exhaustive rows
# sit at about 1%; the Integrated smoke and live rows, the timer-race
# positive and the Effects live row at about 2%, since each rests on one
# or two runs), widened further where repeat runs of the same config
# spread (the AgentEffects VIEW and SYMMETRY rows). Depth is "-" on every
# row because TLC's reported BFS depth overshoots by a level under
# -workers auto, which both the per-pull-request lane and the nightly use.
# 1082 s. MaxTimerGen 2 did not finish in 3000 s (R13), so the row stays at
# MCAgentEffects.smoke.cfg: R2, R7-R9, R20, 222504 to 222728 distinct.
# MCAgentEffects.exhaustive.cfg: R11, R16, R17, 1942312 to 1944848 distinct.
